selection.objective: Expected value of the next marginal dollar, including retained economics, remaining costs, delay and waiting.
selection.completed_scope: Three coordinated workstreams: current-portfolio reassessment, additional exact-use screening, and advancement of conditional lead APR-246/AEC using Firecrawl.
selection.rank_meaning: Priority for additional consequential information if accessible at an appropriate cost; not a quantified financial-asset ranking.
missing_novelty_scope: any other uninspected historical screens or unrecognized aliases
selection.additional_information_queue_scope: A36/HD, then dipyridamole/ALS, then atorvastatin/SRD5A3 within-screen document-level priority only; no insertion into a quantified global investment ranking.
selection.current_capital_decision: Keep capital uncommitted pending an obtainable, priced, decision-changing opportunity; this is not a finding of negative underlying program EV.
selection.retained_round24_information_queue_scope: Inherited SGPL1, VS-X4, ATP1A3 within-screen information order; not repriced against the Round25 screen.
selection.next_advancement_decision: Evaluate a defined APR article/evidence-route/access/output-rights package with separate qualification and useful-function scopes and actual terms.
selection.source_closure_rule: Only consequential new evidence, access, rights, or scoped cost facts reopen a named decision; no automatic reopening of completed source passes.
